[GOOS:plan9] skip 'logos conc needs named pipes'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

cd bank

# Neither the linter nor the race detector sees an inversion that did
# not deadlock: the two transfers run one after the other.
logos lint ./...
! stderr .
[race] [cgo] env CGO_ENABLED=1
[race] [cgo] logos test -race -count=1 ./opposite
[race] [cgo] stdout '^ok '

# The monitor names both goroutines and both locks of each, and the
# finding makes the exit status 1 although the program exited 0.
! logos conc run ./opposite
stdout '^transfers done$'
stderr '^.*opposite[/\\]main\.lgo:30: \[conc::lock_order_inversion\] '
stderr '^\t.*main\.lgo:30: '
stderr '^\t.*main\.lgo:29: '
stderr '^\t.*main\.lgo:20: '
stderr '^\t.*main\.lgo:19: '
stderr '^\tfix: '
stderr -count=1 'lock_order_inversion'

! logos conc run --json-diagnostics ./opposite
stderr '^\{"schema_version":"1\.0","severity":"deny","rule_id":"conc::lock_order_inversion","file":".*main\.lgo","span":\{"start_line":30,'
stderr '"note":"\\t.*main\.lgo:30: .*\\tfix: '
! stderr '^\t'

! logos conc test -count=1 ./opposite
stdout '^ok '
stderr '\[conc::lock_order_inversion\]'

# One order gives no finding, and the status of the program is kept.
logos conc run ./oneorder
stdout '^transfers done$'
! stderr .
logos conc test -count=1 ./oneorder
! stderr 'conc::'

! logos conc run ./oneorder fail
stderr '^exit status 3$'
! stderr 'conc::'

# A program whose last stderr byte is a colon still forwards its own
# status: "operation failed:" runs into the wrapper's "exit status 3".
! logos conc run ./failing
stderr 'operation failed:exit status 3$'
! stderr 'conc::'

# A helper that inherits stderr and reports its own status after the
# program exits cannot replace the program's status.
! logos conc run ./helper
stderr -count=1 '^exit status 1$'
stderr 'exit status 9'
! stderr 'conc::'

# A plain build does not carry the monitor.
logos run ./opposite
! stderr .

-- bank/go.mod --
module example.com/bank

go 1.27
-- bank/opposite/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"logos/sync"
)

type account struct{ balance int }

var (
	checking sync.Locked[account]
	savings  sync.Locked[account]
)

func save(amount int) error {
	checking.WithLock(from => {
		savings.WithLock(to => {
			from.balance -= amount
			to.balance += amount
		})
	})
	return nil
}

func spend(amount int) error {
	savings.WithLock(from => {
		checking.WithLock(to => {
			from.balance -= amount
			to.balance += amount
		})
	})
	return nil
}

func transfers(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go save(10)
	}
	go group (ctx) {
		go spend(4)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := transfers(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	fmt.Println("transfers done")
}
-- bank/opposite/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestTransfers(t *testing.T) {
	if err := transfers(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
-- bank/oneorder/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"os"

	"logos/sync"
)

type account struct{ balance int }

var (
	checking sync.Locked[account]
	savings  sync.Locked[account]
)

func save(amount int) error {
	checking.WithLock(from => {
		savings.WithLock(to => {
			from.balance -= amount
			to.balance += amount
		})
	})
	return nil
}

func transfers(ctx context.Context) error {
	go group (ctx) {
		go save(10)
	}
	go group (ctx) {
		go save(-4)
	}
	return nil
}

func main() {
	if err := transfers(context.Background()); err != nil {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	fmt.Println("transfers done")
	if len(os.Args) > 1 {
		os.Exit(3)
	}
}

-- bank/failing/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Fprint(os.Stderr, "operation failed:")
	os.Exit(3)
}
-- bank/helper/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"os"
	"os/exec"
	"time"
)

func main() {
	helper := exec.Command(os.Args[0], "-helper-child")
	helper.Stderr = os.Stderr
	if err := helper.Start(); err != nil {
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, err)
		os.Exit(2)
	}
	fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "program done")
	os.Exit(1)
}

func init() {
	if len(os.Args) > 1 && os.Args[1] == "-helper-child" {
		time.Sleep(200 * time.Millisecond)
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "exit status 9")
		os.Exit(0)
	}
}

-- bank/oneorder/main_test.lgo --
package main

import "testing"

func TestTransfers(t *testing.T) {
	if err := transfers(t.Context()); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
}
